intro.en: Visitors love these laid-back beach towns for their excellent food, great surfing, beautiful beaches, and family-friendly atmosphere.
intro.es: Los visitantes aman estos pueblos costeros por su comida excelente, surfing fantástico, playas hermosas y ambiente familiar.

picks.name: Mary's Taco Sayulita
picks.en: Get fish and shrimp tacos; generous portions though reviews are mixed.
picks.es: Come por los tacos de camarón y pescado; porciones generosas, pero las opiniones son mixtas.
picks.quote: My husband would double agree with you for the mary's fish and shrimp tacos. He dreams of them.

picks.name: La Lancha Beach
picks.en: Perfect for beginner surfers with small waves, uncrowded water, and local instructors available.
picks.es: Perfecta para surfistas principiantes con olas pequeñas, agua tranquila e instructores locales disponibles.
picks.when: February best for waves, good for lessons
picks.quote: It was my first time surfing ever, and I was very grateful for the small waves and uncrowded waters.

picks.name: Don Pedro's Restaurant & Bar
picks.en: Upscale restaurant with ocean views, excellent for large groups and special occasions.
picks.es: Restaurante de lujo con vistas al océano, excelente para grupos grandes y ocasiones especiales.
picks.quote: On the more fancy/expensive side but good for large groups and great view of the ocean with an awesome menu.

picks.name: Lo de Marcos
picks.en: Quiet beach town with calm waters perfect for swimming and peaceful beach days.
picks.es: Pueblo de playa tranquilo con aguas calmadas perfectas para nadar y días pacíficos en la playa.
picks.quote: Lo of Marcos is a very sleepy, laid back town, go for lunch and a wander on the fine sandy beach.

picks.name: Sayulita Sandbar
picks.en: Sports bar with free games, cheap burgers and wings, live music; perfect for meeting people.
picks.es: Bar deportivo con juegos gratis, hamburguesas y alitas económicas, música en vivo; perfecto para conocer gente.
picks.when: open 2pm Saturdays, events nightly except Tuesdays
picks.quote: I love the sandbar on revolucion. Amazing food and loads of games and cool people. V big too.

picks.name: Playa Los Muertos
picks.en: Gentle beach with protective rocks and calm waters, best for families and swimmers.
picks.es: Playa tranquila con rocas protectoras y aguas calmadas, ideal para familias y nadadores.
picks.quote: The only beach we swim at in Sayulita is Los Muertos - the rocks surrounding it break up the cross-tide and it's much gentler.

picks.name: Playa Carricitos
picks.en: Hike or drive to this secluded beach for the most beautiful sunsets you'll ever see.
picks.es: Camina o conduce a esta playa aislada para los atardeceres más bellos que jamás hayas visto.
picks.quote: I saw the most beautiful sunset of my life there and saw whales jump out of the water.
picks.vibe: secluded beach, pristine sunsets, virtually no crowds

picks.name: Public House
picks.en: Sports bar with craft beers on the plaza; great for watching World Cup and Mexico games.
picks.es: Bar deportivo con cervezas artesanales en la plaza; excelente para ver Copa Mundial y partidos de México.
picks.quote: So many great places to watch World Cup and during Mexico games the place is popping.
picks.vibe: lively sports bar, craft beers, plaza location

picks.name: Tacos Al Pastor Tal Ivan
picks.en: Quick and cheap al pastor tacos on the plaza with long hours.
picks.es: Tacos al pastor rápidos y económicos en la plaza con horarios extendidos.
picks.quote: They have the best Al pastor tacos.

picks.name: Hotelito Los Sueños
picks.en: Hotel with daily yoga, great breakfast buffet with vegan options, and two pools near beach.
picks.es: Hotel con yoga diario, excelente buffet de desayuno con opciones veganas y dos piscinas cerca de la playa.
picks.when: breakfast until 1130, morning and evening yoga
picks.quote: Great breakfast buffet with lots of options, daily yoga opportunities, 2 pools, quiet area steps from the beach.
picks.vibe: yoga-focused hotel, breakfast buffet, quiet beach

picks.name: Sur 38
picks.en: Upscale tapas and wine spot with intimate, cozy atmosphere.
picks.es: Lugar elegante de tapas y vino con atmósfera íntima y acogedora.
picks.quote: We like to go to Sur38 for tapas and wine, it's a little fancier.
picks.vibe: upscale tapas and wine, intimate setting

picks.name: Surf It Out
picks.en: Book Risa for surf lessons; she's the best instructor and her dog surfs too.
picks.es: Reserva a Risa para clases de surf; es la mejor instructora y su perro también practica surf.
picks.quote: Risa at surf it out is hands down the best you could book.

picks.name: Tacos Toño
picks.en: Get suadero at this late-night stand: the fat melts in your mouth.
picks.es: Prueba suadero en este puesto nocturno: la grasa se derrite en tu boca.
picks.quote: Suadero is my fave - the fat melts in your mouth
picks.vibe: older couple, cash only, crowded nights

picks.name: Alley Cat Tours
picks.en: Take a catamaran to Isla Marietas with snorkeling and all-inclusive food.
picks.es: Toma un catamarán a Isla Marietas con snorkel y comida incluida.
picks.quote: 1000% yes. I've been to Mexico 13 times and this was by far the best boat excursion.

picks.name: Alto Alto
picks.en: Try Alto Alto for fancy Mediterranean dinner, perfect for special occasions.
picks.es: Prueba Alto Alto para cena mediterránea elegante, perfecta para ocasiones especiales.
picks.quote: Dinner at Alto Alto was great for a fun, upscale location

picks.name: Aaleyah's Wings
picks.en: Grab margaritas and wings at Aaleyah's for real, unfussy Mexican food.
picks.es: Prueba margaritas y alitas en Aaleyah's, comida mexicana real y despreocupada.
picks.quote: if you want real! not touristy mexican food go to Aaleyah's.

picks.name: Viajero Hostel
picks.en: Stay at Viajero for nightly events, yoga, and a friendly, social scene.
picks.es: Alójate en Viajero para eventos nocturnos, yoga y un ambiente amigable y social.
picks.quote: They make you feel at home and i knew all of them by name after my trip

picks.name: Pineapple Paradise
picks.en: Hit Pineapple Paradise for smash burger tacos and specialty cocktails in a lively spot.
picks.es: Ve a Pineapple Paradise por smash burger tacos y cócteles especiales en un lugar animado.
picks.quote: Go to Pineapple Paradise for the smash burger taco(be sure to try the jalapeno relish).

picks.name: My Sister's House
picks.en: Stay at My Sister's House—a women-only hostel with yoga, cooking classes, and budget living.
picks.es: Quédate en My Sister's House, un albergue solo para mujeres con yoga, clases de cocina, y hospedaje económico.
picks.quote: You can cook outside and there is a fridge on the patio. So cheap also!

picks.name: Monkey Mountain
picks.en: Hike Monkey Mountain from Higuera Blanca; bring water, sunscreen, and good shoes for this hot trail.
picks.es: Camina Monkey Mountain desde Higuera Blanca; trae agua, protector solar, y buenos zapatos para esta caminata caliente.
picks.quote: Monkey mountain is easy alone. Uber to Higuera Blanca, and then follow the trail using Alltrails. Wear good shoes and sunscreen, take water, it is a hot one.

picks.name: Northswell Cafe
picks.en: Northswell serves amazing vegan breakfast and those chorizo burritos everyone raves about.
picks.es: Northswell sirve un desayuno vegano increíble y esos burritos de chorizo que todos alaban.
picks.quote: Northswell is wonderful (looooove the chorizo burrito)

picks.name: The Dock
picks.en: The Dock's a great beachfront dinner spot with good food, drinks, and an awesome vibe.
picks.es: The Dock es un excelente restaurante frente a la playa para cenar con buena comida, bebidas, y ambiente genial.
picks.quote: We went to it our first night in town. It was right on the beach, good food, good drinks, it was so nice

picks.name: Marietas Islands
picks.en: Book a day-trip snorkel tour to Marietas Islands with equipment, park fees, and lunch included.
picks.es: Reserva un tour de snorkel de día a las Islas Marietas con equipo, tarifas de parque, y almuerzo incluido.
picks.quote: 1600 pesos for an incredible trip to Las Marietas that included snorkeling equipment, park fees, and lunch.

picks.name: Kapital Bank
picks.en: Kapital Bank's ATMs on Avenida Revolucion are the most reliable for consistent cash access in town.
picks.es: Los cajeros del Banco Kapital en Avenida Revolucion son los más confiables para acceso de efectivo consistente en el pueblo.
picks.quote: The ATM situation is still bad but has improved in the last 2 weeks. Kapitol bank just reopened their ATM's.

picks.name: El Espresso
picks.en: Get the amazing chilaquiles at this central plaza cafe beloved for breakfast.
picks.es: Come los increibles chilaquiles en este cafe de plaza central amado por el desayuno.
picks.quote: food was amazing we got the chilaqules

picks.name: M&F Coffee Roasters
picks.en: Order their freshly roasted medium roast from Nayarit or Chiapas beans.
picks.es: Pide su cafe de tueste medio recien tostado de los granos Nayarit o Chiapas.
picks.quote: I smelled the distinct aroma of roasting coffee

picks.name: Tropical House Cafe
picks.en: Get the amazing ceviche and spicy margarita while chatting with Luis, the sweetest bartender.
picks.es: Come el increible ceviche y margarita picante mientras platicas con Luis, el bartender mas dulce.
picks.quote: Go see Luis at Tropical House - they have amazing ceviche, and a delicioussss spicy margarita!
picks.vibe: friendly bar, great staff, ocean view

picks.name: The Embers
picks.en: Experience dinner that becomes a nightclub, with dancing till sunrise on weekends.
picks.es: Vive cena que se convierte en discoteca, con baile hasta la madrugada los fines de semana.
picks.quote: After dinner they take the tables away and it turns into a club with dancing so they are prepared to host large groups.

picks.name: Rincón de Guayabitos
picks.en: Just 20 minutes north, this beach town offers similar charm at much lower prices.
picks.es: A solo 20 minutos al norte, este pueblo costero ofrece encanto similar a precios mucho mas bajos.
picks.quote: Checkout rincon de guayabitos 20 min north for rent half the price

picks.name: Choco Banana
picks.en: Get the surprisingly delicious bean burger, especially popular with vegan diners.
picks.es: Come la hamburguesa de frijoles sorprendentemente deliciosa, especialmente popular con diners vegetarianos.
picks.quote: The bean burger at Chocobanana was surprisingly awesome!

picks.name: Matiz Mariscos
picks.en: Try the atun tostada at this seafood lunch spot.
picks.es: Pide la tostada de atún en Matiz, es excelente para comer.
picks.quote: Go to Matiz and get the atun tostada, thank me later!!

picks.name: Naty's Cocina
picks.en: Grab vegetarian tacos at Naty's before they close mid-afternoon.
picks.es: Prueba los tacos vegetarianos en Naty's antes de que cierren.
picks.quote: I remember Naty's Cocina as having amazing delicious vegetarian tacos.

picks.name: Escondido Bar
picks.en: Escondido makes the best cocktails in town with great daytime vibes.
picks.es: Pide los mejores cócteles en Escondido con excelente ambiente.
picks.quote: It's like a working bar during the day with good wifi, good vibes.

picks.name: Tierra Tropical Beach Club
picks.en: Spend a day at this luxurious beach club with excellent food and drinks.
picks.es: Pasa un día en este club de playa lujoso con excelente comida y bebidas.
picks.quote: it's heaven! $500 pesos for the day, but you can stay all day and it's so luxurious and quiet!

picks.name: Marea Cafe
picks.en: Marea serves great sandwiches and coffee with a lovely vibe in Plaza Nawalli.
picks.es: Marea sirve excelentes sándwiches y café con un ambiente agradable en Plaza Nawalli.
picks.quote: Idk if the coffee is particularly great or anything, but I really loved the vibe at Marea Cafe.

picks.name: Carbon
picks.en: Carbon's patio serves fantastic burgers in a cozy, quiet neighborhood spot.
picks.es: El patio de Carbon sirve hamburguesas fantásticas en un lugar acogedor y tranquilo.
picks.quote: it's a little street patio in the north side so it's quieter. it's such a cozy vibe.
picks.vibe: cozy street patio, quiet, open kitchen

picks.name: El Itacate
picks.en: Try their amazing itacate burrito and fresh aguas frescas at this neighborhood spot.
picks.es: Prueba su increíble burrito itacate y las aguas frescas en este lugar del barrio.
picks.quote: a burrito with a cheese wrap instead of tortilla...sooooo good

picks.name: Tiburón
picks.en: Their fish of the day and tuna poke wontons are excellent; try the watermelon margarita.
picks.es: El pescado del día y los wontons de atún son excelentes, prueba la margarita de sandía.
picks.quote: Great fish of the day, ahi wonton appetizer and specials
picks.vibe: breezy seafood, great cocktails, friendly service

picks.name: Julia's Jungle Kitchen
picks.en: Go for the best coffee in town and great breakfast and lunch options.
picks.es: Ve por el mejor café del pueblo y excelentes opciones de desayuno y almuerzo.
picks.quote: Julia's is open, best coffee!
picks.vibe: cozy cafe inside Nawalli's Plaza, best coffee

picks.name: Bichos Tacos
picks.en: Try the birria tacos that people rave about as incredibly fresh and flavorful.
picks.es: Prueba los tacos de birria que la gente elogia como increíblemente frescos y sabrosos.
picks.quote: the tacos are so fresh and yummy
picks.vibe: casual taco spot, fresh and vibrant

street.name: Tacos Al Pastor Tal Ivan
street.en: Quick and cheap al pastor tacos on the plaza with long hours.
street.es: Tacos al pastor rápidos y económicos en la plaza con horarios extendidos.
street.quote: They have the best Al pastor tacos.

street.name: Tacos Toño
street.en: Get suadero at this late-night stand: the fat melts in your mouth.
street.es: Prueba suadero en este puesto nocturno: la grasa se derrite en tu boca.
street.quote: Suadero is my fave - the fat melts in your mouth
street.vibe: older couple, cash only, crowded nights

street.name: Naty's Cocina
street.en: Grab vegetarian tacos at Naty's before they close mid-afternoon.
street.es: Prueba los tacos vegetarianos en Naty's antes de que cierren.
street.quote: I remember Naty's Cocina as having amazing delicious vegetarian tacos.

street.name: Churro Couple
street.en: The Churro Couple stand is a street favorite you can't pass without grabbing some.
street.es: El Churro Couple es un favorito callejero que no puedes pasar sin agarrar algunos.
street.quote: I second the churro couple. Can't walk by without getting some.

street.name: Mimi's Cake Stand
street.en: Get the tres leches cakes at this plaza stand, locals swear by them.
street.es: Consigue los pasteles de tres leches en este puesto de plaza, son increíbles.
street.quote: Mimi's cakes are so damn good.
street.vibe: plaza stand, local favorite, fresh sweets

street.name: Burrito Revolution
street.en: Try Burrito Revolución food truck for amazing vegetarian burritos with awesome sauces.
street.es: Prueba el food truck Burrito Revolución por sus increíbles burritos vegetarianos.
street.quote: The owner was cool, sat down with my wife and myself and chatted for awhile and then he brought a bottle of tequila to the table and he kept pouring four or five shots for him and I on the house.
street.vibe: food truck, friendly owner, fresh vegetarian

street.name: Don Crispin
street.en: Find Don Crispin's wheelbarrow for the best coffee in town.
street.es: Busca la carretilla de Don Crispin para el mejor café del pueblo.
street.quote: Best coffee in town by far.

skip.name: Mary's Taco Sayulita
quotes: tortillas were soggy and food was very heavy, did not taste fresh
Tortillas were soggy and food was very heavy, did not taste fresh

skip.name: Kaliva
quotes: Expat places I would avoid would be Kaliva/Sports Garden, Xoc
kaliva was almost double most of the smaller places

tips.en: Budget 1,000 to 2,000 pesos daily for comfortable meals.
tips.es: Presupuesta 1,000 a 2,000 pesos diarios para comidas.

tips.en: Rain mostly falls at night; avoid beach 11am-5pm.
tips.es: Lluvia mayormente nocturna; evita playa entre 11am-5pm.

tips.en: Pay in pesos for best prices and worker preference.
tips.es: Paga en pesos para mejores precios y preferencia.

tips.en: Take local buses for budget transport; under $3 cost.
tips.es: Toma autobuses locales para transporte barato, menos de $3.

tips.en: Visit November for fewer rain days; October is unpredictable.
tips.es: Visita noviembre para menos lluvia; octubre es impredecible.

tips.en: Rent homes via Facebook groups or Sayulitalife.com.
tips.es: Renta casas en grupos de Facebook o Sayulitalife.com.

tips.en: Families with kids welcome; February and August ideal.
tips.es: Familias con niños bienvenidas; febrero y agosto ideales.

tips.en: Hike jungle trails and take surf lessons.
tips.es: Haz senderismo en la selva y lecciones de surf.
